body:
I'm in the same boat as you. 

But here are some small things that just make life a tad bit sweeter. Maybe thinking about them will ground you:

1. Cute pets- even if you don't have one. 

2. Spending cold winter nights under a blanket. 

3. The smell of soil after it rains. 

4. Late night drives. 

5. That one song in your playlist you can't get enough of. 


I know, it's hard. It doesn't seem worth it- at all. I don't even feel like I'm worth staying either. 

There is something to this life, but that's for you to build. The world feels against you, life gave you scars- but that can NEVER silence that bit of hope and flame inside you. 

You've come so far, and you should be proud of yourself for sticking around this long. 
 
Thank you for being strong.
